final_topology.title: Government Segmented Network
final_topology.description: A network with distinct zones for standard and sensitive information systems, each with dedicated administrative infrastructure.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes separate zones for standard and sensitive systems, each with its own administrative infrastructure. The standard zone has a secure internet gateway, while the sensitive zone is isolated and protected by a Class 1 gateway.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management Zone' (z8) with an 'Asset Inventory System' (n25) that manages various nodes and zones, indicating a detailed asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation Zone' (z9) with a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n26) that manages various nodes and zones, indicating data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Systems' (z1) and 'Sensitive Systems' (z2), each with dedicated administrative infrastructure, indicating data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n5, n6) in various zones, indicating firewalls are implemented and managed on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n11) in the 'Internet Gateway Zone' (z5) and links to various nodes, indicating trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Server' (n27) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10) and links to the 'Centralized AAA Server' (n14), indicating MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' (n12) in the 'Internet Gateway Zone' (z5) and links to various nodes, indicating DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n13) in the 'Internet Gateway Zone' (z5) and links to various nodes, indicating network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for different types of systems and administrative functions, indicating a secure network architecture is established and maintained.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes various management links and zones, indicating network infrastructure is securely managed.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Centralized AAA Server' (n14) in the 'Standard Admin Zone' (z3) and links to various nodes, indicating centralized AAA is implemented.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' (n28) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10) and links to the 'Remote Device' (n29) and 'Centralized AAA Server' (n14), indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes 'NIDS' (n15, n16) in the 'Standard Systems Zone' (z1) and 'Sensitive Systems Zone' (z2), indicating a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n5, n6) and links between different zones, indicating traffic filtering is performed between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control System' (n30) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10) and links to the 'Remote Device' (n29) and 'Centralized AAA Server' (n14), indicating access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' (n17) in the 'Standard Admin Zone' (z3) and links to NIDS (n15, n16), indicating network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Systems Zone' (z6) separate from the 'Standard Systems Zone' (z1) and 'Sensitive Systems Zone' (z2), indicating production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'External Penetration Testing Zone' (z7) with a 'Penetration Testing Workstation' (n24) and links to the 'Internet Gateway Zone' (z5), indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show an asset inventory system or process. However, it includes various nodes and zones that could be part of an inventory.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology shows various links and zones, but there is no explicit documentation of data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows is shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a centralized AAA server (n14) but does not explicitly show MFA for remote access.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit MFA for remote access is shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing MFA and links to remote access points.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a centralized AAA server (n14) but does not explicitly show a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit VPN or remote device connections are shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to remote devices and the AAA server.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a centralized AAA server (n14) but does not explicitly show access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit access control for remote assets is shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing access control and links to remote assets and the AAA server.
